title: Langevin dynamics for high-dimensional optimization: the case of multi-spiked tensor PCA
abstract: arXiv:2408.06401v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study nonconvex optimization in high dimensions through Langevin dynamics, focusing on the multi-spiked tensor PCA problem. In this tensor estimation model, the goal is to recover a finite number of hidden signal vectors, or spikes, from noisy Gaussian tensor observations using maximum likelihood estimation. We characterize the number of samples required for Langevin dynamics to efficiently recover the spikes and identify the separation conditions on the signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) needed for exact recovery. In particular, we show that the sample complexity required to recover the spike associated with the largest SNR matches the well-known algorithmic threshold for the single-spike case, whereas the threshold degrades when recovering all spikes. translated_title: 高维优化中的朗之万动力学：多尖峰张量PCA的情形
translated_abstract: arXiv:2408.06401v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们通过朗之万动力学研究高维非凸优化，重点关注多尖峰张量PCA问题。在该张量估计模型中，目标是通过最大似然估计，从含噪声的高斯张量观测中恢复有限数量的隐藏信号向量（即尖峰）。我们刻画了朗之万动力学有效恢复尖峰所需的样本数量，并确定了实现精确恢复所需的信噪比（SNRs）分离条件。特别地，我们表明，恢复与最大SNR相关的尖峰所需的样本复杂度与单尖峰情形下众所周知的算法阈值相匹配，而恢复所有尖峰时阈值会退化。一个关键要素是通过尖峰相关性对朗之万轨迹进行精确的低维描述，该描述同时捕捉了高维动力学。
tldr: 本文揭示了在多尖峰张量PCA中，朗之万动力学恢复最大信噪比尖峰的样本复杂度与单尖峰情形一致，但恢复所有尖峰时阈值会退化，并提供了基于低维相关性描述的理论刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that Langevin dynamics achieves the same sample complexity for recovering the largest-SNR spike as in the single-spike case, while the threshold degrades for recovering all spikes, with a low-dimensional correlation-based characterization.
